NDIS Social and Community Participation

Support to get out, connect and build confidence in the community, with worker matching and goals that put your choice and control first.

Registered NDIS provider 4-L7JCZ6S Goal-focused support Matched workers Culturally responsive
Increased social and community participation

Get out, connect and grow your confidence

Social and community participation is support to take part in the life around you, on your terms. Whether the goal is more social connection, new skills, or more confidence getting out and about, we help you get there.

Your goals lead and your worker supports, step by step, at a pace that feels right for you.

  • Support to access the community and stay connected
  • Skill-building and travel training in real settings
  • A matched worker who shares your interests

Ask about community support

Send a quick enquiry and we will call you back within one business day.

We usually reply within one business day, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Your details are used only to respond to your enquiry.

What you receive

What social and community participation includes

Every plan is different. These are the ways we most often help people take part.

Getting out and joining in

Support to attend community activities, groups and events, so it is easier to say yes and take part.

Building social connection

Help to meet people, keep up friendships and reduce isolation, at a pace that feels right.

Skills for everyday life

Practising real world skills like planning, budgeting and communication in the places you use them.

Travel and getting around

Travel training and support to use public transport with growing confidence and independence.

Appointments and errands

A hand to get to appointments, shopping and local errands, and to stay on top of your week.

Confidence at your pace

Gentle, step by step support to try new places and groups without feeling rushed or overwhelmed.

Ideas that fit real life

Ideas for getting out and about

Community participation looks different for everyone. Your goals lead, and your worker supports. Some of the places and activities people choose include the following.

Local library Place of worship Parks and walks Cafes and catch ups Shopping centres Sport and gym Classes and hobbies Volunteering
Who it helps

Who community participation suits

This support suits people whose NDIS goals include getting out more, building independence, or feeling more connected.

  • People who feel isolated and want more social connection
  • Anyone building confidence in busy or new environments
  • Those learning to travel and get around independently
  • People working towards study, volunteering or work goals
You lead the way

Your choice and control, your goals

Choice and control sit at the heart of the NDIS, and at the heart of how we work. You decide where you go, who supports you and how quickly you build up. We plan around your goals, then check in and adjust as your confidence grows.

  • Goals set by you, reviewed with you
  • A matched worker who shares your language or culture where you prefer
  • Progress notes so you can see how far you have come
The Ahsan difference

Support matched to how you live

Getting out is easier with someone who gets you. We match you with a worker who fits your language, gender preference, culture and interests, so community time feels natural, not supervised.

LanguageWorkers who speak your language
Gender preferenceMale or female workers as you prefer
Culture and faithRespect for your background and beliefs
Routine and continuityThe same familiar faces, your way
Getting started

How community support starts

Needs check

We talk through your goals, interests and any support needs.

Plan alignment

We confirm your goals match your NDIS plan and funding.

Match your worker

We pair you with a worker who fits your interests and preferences.

First sessions

Early outings focus on comfort, safety and getting to know each other.

Progress check ins

We review what is working and celebrate the wins.

Ongoing support

We keep building, with a schedule that grows with your confidence.

Funding and pricing

How this support is funded

If it is a reasonable and necessary support in your NDIS plan, this service is funded from your plan budget. Community participation may be funded under Core Supports, Assistance with Social and Community Participation, or as Capacity Building, Increased Social and Community Participation.

  • Plan managed, self managed and NDIA managed participants are all welcome
  • Pricing follows the NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits, and your Government Approved Budget
  • No call out fee and no lock in contracts
  • Support that follows your goals, not a fixed roster

NDIS pricing arrangements

Getting a quote is simple.

Tell us your plan management type and the support you are after. We will explain what can be claimed and provide a clear service agreement before anything starts. There are no surprises and no obligation.

Request a free quote

Clear boundaries

What community support does not cover

We keep this support focused on participation and skills. Some needs are better met by another support.

  • Clinical or nursing only needs, which sit with our nursing care team
  • Formal legal or advocacy representation
  • One size fits all group rosters with no personal goals
  • Any promise of a guaranteed outcome, since progress is personal
Explore more support

Related NDIS supports

Personal care and daily living support to help you get ready and get out.

Explore this support

Household Tasks

A clean, safe home so you can focus on the things you enjoy.

Explore this support

Muslim and Culturally Responsive Support

Community support that respects your faith, language and family.

Explore this support
Where we work

Melbourne and Sydney

We are a service-area provider. Our team comes to you at home and in your community. We support community access across both cities, from quiet local outings to busier venues, always at your pace.

Melbourne support areas   Sydney support areas

Melbourne suburbs we support include

DerrimutFootscrayWerribeeMaribyrnong

Sydney suburbs we support include

ParramattaLiverpoolBankstownFairfield

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Anywhere that supports your goals and is safe, from the local library, park or place of worship to shops, classes, sport or volunteering. You choose, and we plan around it.

Yes. On the NDIS this support appears as social and community participation, and as increased social and community participation under Capacity Building. We deliver both, guided by your plan.

Yes. Travel training is a common goal. We build up gradually, from planning a trip to travelling with support and then travelling more independently.

We aim for continuity, so you build a real rapport with a matched worker. Familiar support makes getting out feel far more comfortable.

Absolutely. We can match you with a worker who shares your language or culture, and support activities that matter to you, including attending your place of worship.

Let us help

Ready to get out and connect?

Talk to a real person about the support you need. We will listen first, explain your options clearly, and match you with the right worker. No pressure, no obligation.

Melbourne 0433 650 084 Sydney 0416 623 317

Request a free consultation

We usually reply within one business day, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Your details are used only to respond to your enquiry.
